description: This Java class 'MerchantUtils' provides utility functions related to merchant stores, such as generating footer messages. Currently, it contains only one method, 'getFooterMessage', which constructs a message based on store data and provided prefix/suffix.

classes.name: MerchantUtils
classes.description: Utility class for merchant-related helper methods.

methods.name: getFooterMessage
methods.description: Constructs a footer message for a merchant store based on optional prefix and suffix and store's 'business since' date.
